openrouter.reserve_rule: len(utf-8 bytes of serialized request JSON) as input tokens + pinned_max_tokens output

deepgram.credit_note: Deepgram usage is funded by free credits: it is informational only, never consumes OpenRouter cash caps, and never raises a cash BudgetError.
deepgram.reserve_rule: ceil((max_audio_seconds + context_pad_seconds) * channels) billed seconds times regular usd_per_minute. Includes silence and prefix/context PCM actually sent. Does not use websocket wall time.
deepgram.session_pad_rule: Every fresh session reserves 2 extra billed seconds before connect for the <=0.5 s per-session prefix and whole-second rounding the sent-PCM bound cannot see. Pads stay reserved unless an exact provider usage audit justifies release.
deepgram.hard_output_mechanism: STT billed by processed audio duration, not transcript tokens
required_before_paid: Director acceptance of these duration bounds
DEEPGRAM_API_KEY and OPENROUTER_API_KEY present without logging values
Reserve ceil sent-audio seconds including context before connect
Settle only from billed usage; keep reserve if usage is missing
